name: api
description: An API that will makes independent data packages with mostly MEI data available

scripts.build:full: npm run fetch-data && npm run build
scripts.build:full:public: npm run fetch-data && npm run build:public
scripts.dist: npm run build:public && npm run package
scripts.dist:local: npm run build && npm run package
scripts.dist:full: npm run fetch-data && npm run dist
scripts.install:xar: xst --server localhost package install local-files dist/*.xar
scripts.docker:dev:rebuild: npm run dist && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --build
scripts.watch:docker: test -f .existdb.json.docker && cp .existdb.json.docker .existdb.json && npm run watch || (echo 'Error: .existdb.json.docker not found. Run: cp .existdb.json.docker.template .existdb.json.docker' && exit 1)
scripts.test:deploy: npm run deploy && npm run test
scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run test

author: Johannes Kepper
